output.sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE LOWER(p.method) = 'card') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS card_payment_pct FROM marts.fct_payments AS p
output.explanation: This counts the payments whose method is card and divides by all payments in marts.fct_payments, as a percentage rounded to 2 decimals. It counts payment records, not amounts, and doesn't filter by order status because you asked about all payments. I assumed card payments are recorded with the method value 'card' (matched regardless of case).
